_comment: T4 (review 2026-10-10): the phone clock (app/src/transport/clock.js) as step sequences, GENERATED by gen-clock-cases.mjs from clock.js itself; never edit by hand. A step is seed {server_t, now}, sample {t_node, server_t, now} (one time_req/time_res round trip), new_burst (a reconnect) or restart (control{clock_resync}). Every step records the offset after it; a sample also records whether it was accepted. The clock starts with no samples and offset 0, burst 5, alpha 0.2. Read by app/test/clock-cases.test.mjs (clock.js) and mcp/tests/test_clock_cases.py (the stand-in phone, mock_node.py MockNode).

cases.name: the first burst keeps the smallest-rtt sample and replaces the offset
after the burst every sample moves the offset by the alpha 0.2 EWMA
a one-way delay skews the offset by half the asymmetry
an rtt over 3x the running median is rejected and keeps the offset
the median of an even count averages the middle two
no outlier check until three rtts are held
a negative rtt is rejected
the welcome seed sets the offset only before any round trip
a reconnect on a synced clock with no step stays on the EWMA
a reconnect after a wall-clock step over CLOCK_STEP_MS (3000 ms) snaps to the best sample
a reconnect after a backward step over CLOCK_STEP_MS snaps too
a reconnect step just under CLOCK_STEP_MS does not snap
a reconnect on a part-synced clock replaces the offset for the samples still owed
a forced re-sync replaces the offset for the next five samples, then the EWMA resumes
a rejected sample during a forced re-sync does not count toward it
the outlier median forgets an rtt 33 samples old (a 40 ms probe is rejected)
the outlier median keeps exactly 32 rtts (a 200 ms probe after 20 + 16 is rejected)
the outlier median keeps exactly 32 rtts (a 40 ms probe after 20 + 16 is accepted)
the outlier check starts at exactly three held rtts
a burst tie on rtt keeps the first sample
a reconnect tie on rtt keeps the first sample for the snap
a reconnect step of exactly CLOCK_STEP_MS does not snap
